gloss: to assign, to allocate, to allot

definitions.gloss: to assign, to allocate, to allot
definitions.explanation: To distribute or apportion something (tasks, resources, roles, etc.) to specific people or purposes.

examples.japanese: {各自|かくじ}に{役割|やくわり}を{割|わ}り{当|あ}てた。
examples.english: I assigned roles to each person.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}を{各|かく}プロジェクトに{割|わ}り{当|あ}てる。
examples.english: Allocate the budget to each project.

examples.japanese: キーボードのショートカットに{機能|きのう}を{割|わ}り{当|あ}てることができる。
examples.english: You can assign functions to keyboard shortcuts.

notes:
The noun form {割|わ}り{当|あ}て is very common, especially in business and computing contexts. Also used in IT for assigning addresses, resources, or shortcuts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{役割|やくわり}を{割|わ}り{当|あ}てる — to assign roles
・{予算|よさん}を{割|わ}り{当|あ}てる — to allocate a budget
・{時間|じかん}を{割|わ}り{当|あ}てる — to allot time
・IPアドレスを{割|わ}り{当|あ}てる — to assign an IP address

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{配分|はいぶん}する — to distribute, to apportion (more formal)
・{振|ふ}り{分|わ}ける — to sort, to distribute
